body:
The "No license left unsaid" step is red on every pull request: the tree agora's core was ported into carries no license lines.

- `ports/agora-core/CMakeLists.txt`, `ports/agora-core/tests/CMakeLists.txt` — the two build files this tree wrote itself now carry an SPDX identifier (GPL-3.0-only).
- `.github/workflows/check.yml` — `ports/*/tools/golden/*` is excluded from the check. Those are recorded output another build is measured against; a license line above one would say something about its origin that isn't so.

8 lines; no sources change.

comments.body: The change this carried is already on main as 663c9b7: the tidy check now excludes ports/*/tools/golden/* (with the comment saying why the traces are left out), and both CMakeLists of the ported tree carry their SPDX line. It landed as a take-over of this very commit (49e62882) while the pull request stood open, so merging would ask git for a merge of a diff main already has. Closing it rather than leaving it to rot; thanks for the fix it was.

title: Add SPDX license lines and exempt golden traces from the license check
